label: INK GOLD HORIZON
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 50s legendary goddess, muscular athletic physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — shoulders impossibly broad and powerful, arms so densely muscled, each breast massive sitting high on sculpted chest, glutes powerfully rounded, thighs and calves so heavily muscled filling impossible width, silver-white natural hair in tight cornrow crown — body divided into TWO distinct art systems separated by an IRREGULAR JAGGED FRACTURE LINE running exactly at the collarbone/base of neck level erupting into wild branch cracks reaching upward into face and downward into chest — NOT straight, fracture branches like ink bleeding into water WITHOUT EXCEPTION:

UPPER SYSTEM (neck and face above collarbone): BLAZING ELECTRIC GOLD leaf body painting covering EVERY inch of face and neck above fracture zone — ultra-thin gold leaf sheets painted directly onto skin reading as living liquid metal mask, gold surface texture catching every light facet, gold leaf bleeding downward along branch cracks into lower ink territory, NO bare skin visible on face or neck — entirely gold.

LOWER SYSTEM (chest and below): full body traditional Japanese sumi-e ink wash body painting covering EVERY inch from collarbone to ankles — fluid black ink wash painted directly onto skin reading as second skin NOT clothing, each breast individually featuring a sumi-e lotus flower formation as primary focal climax rendered in bold ink brushstroke, ink wash gradients densest at chest fading slightly at ankles, wave and mountain landscape ink wash patterns filling every gap, ink bleeding upward along branch cracks into upper gold face territory.

FRACTURE ZONE: collarbone level boundary — gold leaf dissolving into ink wash at intersection nodes creating dark-gold oxidized hybrid texture, ink wash staining gold surface at fracture edge, branch cracks glowing warm gold where leaf bleeds downward into ink.

Pose: walking stride facing camera 3/4 angle, one leg forward, arms in powerful natural swing, chin raised commanding warrior goddess presence, gold face catching light dramatically as primary visual anchor.
Footwear: bare feet gold toenails.
Nails: extra long stiletto nails solid gold.
Hair: silver-white tight cornrow crown.

MANDATORY PURE PITCH BLACK VOID BACKGROUND ONLY. ONE woman only. Warm gold spotlight from above catching gold face, cold blue rim from below on ink body, fracture zone at collarbone glowing oxidized gold. Pattern density MAXIMUM both systems — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle, face entirely gold. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
